sqlMap.insert: INSERT INTO T_GAME_CARD(GAME_CARD_NO, TYPE, STATE) VALUES(#gameCardNO#, #type#, #state#)
sqlMap.update: UPDATE T_GAME_CARD SET STATE=#state# WHERE GAME_CARD_NO=#gameCardNO# AND TYPE=#type#
sqlMap.select: SELECT SUBSTRING(GAME_CARD_NO,1,5) ID FROM T_GAME_CARD WHERE TYPE=#type# ORDER BY ID DESC LIMIT 0,1
SELECT GAME_CARD_NO AS gameCardNO, TYPE AS type, STATE AS state FROM T_GAME_CARD WHERE GAME_CARD_NO=#gameCardNO# AND TYPE=#type#
